description_excerpt: About The Role As an Engineer, Technical Services, you deliver expert technical support that enables customers to maximize the performance and reliability of their systems throughout the full equipment lifecycle. Your hands-on expertise and customer-focused approach directly strengthen DKSH's after-sales service capability and deepen long-term client partnerships. What You Will Deliver General responsibilities: • Guide customers and provide technical consultancy and assistance regarding installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control systems and equipment.…
